title: •Darth Vader’s Lightsaber
caption: •Darth Vader’s Lightsaber (V)
game_text: Deploy on Vader. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a Jedi or Skywalker for free. Draw 3 destiny and choose 2. Target hit (may place any Interrupt from opponent’s Lost Pile out of play) and forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Vader’s lightsaber. Symbol of the most feared man in the galaxy. Vader’s control of the dark side of the Force allows him to wield this weapon in surprising ways.

notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip's heading and caption (Vader’s). Green Character Weapon frame, banner CHARACTER WEAPON. No inline icons; slip text matches the stub (curly apostrophe in opponent’s). Lore matches the scan; corrected only for curly apostrophes in Vader’s (twice; wiki straight) — confirmed on the 745 px V8 remake. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright line is the SE-style form with 2000, legible. Modern: V8-D-darthvaderslightsaber.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 8 remake — a later different (V) text, same art); VB3 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
